focus.product: Ammunition and defence metal components (cartridge cases, projectile and fuze parts, bomb casings) and their press tooling
focus.why: Turen hosts Pindad's 166-ha munitions division, TKDN-certified (2025) for 5.56, 7.62, 9 and 12.7 mm and large-calibre ammunition. A private plant, PT Sapta Inti Perkasa, has made ammunition in Malang since 2024 and targets hundreds of millions of rounds a year (Republika, Jan 2026). PT Sari Bahari in Pakis is TKDN-certified (76-87%) for practice and live bomb casings. Pindad took a Rp1.5T BTN facility in May 2026 partly for ammunition (earlier notes). Cases, projectiles and fuze parts are deep-drawn and CNC-turned, and the press dies, gauges and fixtures they need suit Malang's mould and CNC shops (Utama Molding, Prima Sakti Asia) and Polinema's manufacturing programmes. Supplier entry runs through Pindad, DEFEND ID and Kemhan licensing. If the map should stay civilian, use the first secondary instead.

also.product: Light CNC machine tools for SMEs: fibre-laser cutters, CNC routers and small milling machines
also.why: Malang has the region's small CNC-machine builders: Pioneer CNC Indonesia (Pakis; builds CNC machines and sells fibre-laser job work), PT Idukasih Robotika (laser-diode CNC, UMM campus) and Naratech (advertised CNC mill, no TKDN record). About 8-9 listed CNC and laser shops (2025-26) add depth. Its UMK is the highest of the five units (67-72% of Surabaya), which favours design-heavy products. Indonesia imported US$71.1M of laser-cutting machines (845611) in 2025, up from $43.6M in 2024; China supplied 62% of HS 8456 (earlier notes).

also.product: Food and farm processing machines: pumps, mills, choppers, retorts, dryers and coffee roasters
also.why: TKDN-certified makers already exist. PT Pabrik Mesin Guntur (Sukun) makes irrigation pumps and rice polishers (TKDN 42.6-58.8%). PT Inovasi Anak Negeri (Pakis) makes choppers, mills, a mini retort, dryers, a ribbon mixer and a coffee roaster (40-48%). CV Tirta Armagitha makes a solar coffee/cocoa dryer. Local inputs include about 20,595 ha of coffee (2021), tea, milk and sugarcane.

focus.product: Spare and wear parts for kretek (cigarette) making machines
focus.why: Gudang Garam is headquartered in Kediri. It had about 208 ha of plants across Kediri and Pasuruan (2013) and 21,964 staff at end-2025, and keeps machine maintenance inside its Kediri production directorate, making it the cluster's largest single user of machine parts. Indonesia imported US$35.2M of tobacco-machinery parts (847890) in 2025: 33% from China, 28% Germany, 10% Korea. Polinema's Kediri campus teaches production-and-maintenance engineering, and UMK is 48-63% of Surabaya's. No local maker of these parts was found, so this is a demand-led bet that needs Gudang Garam's vendor approval. Other TKDN-certified metal and vehicle makers in the cluster (2024-26 lists): PT Bintang Kadiri (aluminium, copper and bimetal compression connectors and cable lugs, Kab. Kediri) and PT Multiparts Rakindo and PT Epower Motor Indonesia (three-wheel and electric motorcycles, Jombang).

also.product: CNC routers, plasma and fibre-laser cutting machines
also.why: CV Inseco CNC Indonesia (Ngadiluwih) has built CNC routers, fibre-laser, plasma and marking machines since 2019 and claims hundreds sold nationwide; Genesis Kediri and Master Tukang sell laser cutting nearby. Laser-machine imports (845611) rose to US$71.1M in 2025 from $43.6M in 2024 (earlier notes). The same routers could carve Tulungagung marble (inference; no CNC marble shop verified).

also.product: Sugar-mill spare parts (shafts, gears, bushings, mill-roller parts)
also.why: Eight mills are listed as active in the cluster: Ngadirejo, Merican, Pesantren Baru, Rejoso Manis Indo, Mojopanggung, Lestari, Cukir and Jombang (Wikipedia list edited Jul 2026). 843890 imports were US$45.8M in 2025 (earlier notes).

focus.product: Rolling-stock components: bogie and underframe parts, couplers, brake parts and interior fittings for INKA
focus.why: INKA (Madiun) is the biggest machined-parts buyer in the five units. Its TKDN rose from 33% to 52% (May 2026), it is building KRLs for KAI Commuter and 50 locomotive platforms for UGL Rail (Australia) to 2028, and its in-group supplier IMS runs an 11-ha component plant. Indonesia's rail-parts imports (8607) jumped to US$182.4M in 2025 from $70.7M in 2023 (China 45%, Japan 24%). The 2025 jump came mostly from 'other' rolling-stock parts (860799: US$91.5M, up from $18.9M in 2023), air brakes (860721: $20.3M, from $3.8M), whole bogies (860712: $14.4M) and couplers and buffers (860730: $7.7M); axles, wheels and bogie parts (860719) were $41.3M. Madiun has the region's deepest rail skills (PNM D4 Perkeretaapian, PPI D3 rail mechanics) and a UMK of about 48% of Surabaya's. Other TKDN-certified makers in the unit (2024-25 lists): PT Mitra Maharta (rice-mill chassis and grain-dryer parts, Ponorogo), PT Refindo Intiselaras Indonesia (steel rock bolts, Kota Madiun) and PT Gunung Mas Bersinar (bus bodies, Kab. Madiun).

also.product: Sugar-mill spare parts (shafts, gears, bushings, mill-roller parts)
also.why: Five sugar mills listed as active in Madiun Raya (Pagotan, Rejoagung, Sudono, Rejosari, Purwodadi; Wikipedia list edited Jul 2026). Gears and shafts (8483) are Indonesia's largest machinable import line (US$843M in 2025, earlier notes).

also.product: 3D-printed masters, patterns and fixtures for fibreglass interior panels
also.why: INKA Multi Solusi makes interior panels and fibreglass parts for INKA in an 11-ha factory at Desa Bagi (2018). Printed masters and fixtures shorten mould-making; this is an inference, not a sourced INKA plan.

focus.product: Coffee and cocoa processing machines (pulpers, hullers, roasters, grinders) and their wear parts
focus.why: Jember is the only place in scope where local firms already make, sell and certify a machine line. RPN/ICCRI's LASINKO pulper, huller, roaster and grinder hold TKDN certificates of 36-53%, and PT Manufacture Dynamic Indonesia builds pulpers and roasters with its own fibre laser, lathe and bending machine. Next door, processors (PT NOR Coffee, Rolas Nusantara Mandiri, Fajar Group, PTPN estates) run roasters, grinders, sorters and deshellers that need wear parts. Indonesia imported US$70.8M of 'other' food-processing machinery (843880, the line holding coffee pulpers) in 2025, 60% from China, plus $45.8M of parts (843890) and $69.1M of commercial hot-drink and food-heating machines (841981, where many roasters are classed; earlier notes). UMK is 47-60% of Surabaya's.

also.product: Sugar-mill spare parts (shafts, gears, bushings, mill-roller and cane-railway parts)
also.why: Nine mills listed as active (Semboro, Glenmore, Asembagus, Panji, Wringinanom, Prajekan, Wonolangan, Gending, Djatiroto). PG Glenmore runs a workshop and PG Djatiroto maintains cane-railway locomotives; PT Intidaya Dinamika Sejati in Jember already runs a machining division.

also.product: Can-seaming and fish-canning line spare parts for Muncar canneries
also.why: Muncar is one of Java's largest fishing ports with many fish plants; PT Sumber Yalasamudra and CV Pasific Harvest can lemuru sardines and run can seamers. No local maker of seamer parts was found; the nearest marine fabricator is PT Blambangan Bahari Shipyard (Srono), which is TKDN-certified for fishing-boat hulls (2024).

focus.product: Propellers, propeller shafts and stern fittings for small fishing and trading boats
focus.why: Madura has a long tradition of motorised wooden cargo and fishing boats: leti-leti from Sumenep (about 1,000 in 1979, motorised from the early 1980s), golekan from Telaga Biru and janggolan from Kamal-Sampang. Indonesia imported US$27.7M of ship and boat propellers (848710) in 2025, up from $16.6M in 2023 (earlier notes). Propellers are cast, then bored, balanced and finished; shafts are turned. Low confidence: no current fleet, boatyard, buyer or machining-firm count was verified in Madura; Bangkalan sits in the Gerbangkertosusila (greater Surabaya) region across the Suramadu bridge.

also.product: Salt-washing and salt-processing machine wear parts
also.why: Sumenep is nicknamed 'Bumi Garam'; PT Garam runs salt factories in Sampang and Camplong and produced 450,107 t of crude salt in 2019 (pre-2023 figure). Washers, crushers and screw conveyors need replaceable stainless parts. Low confidence: no Madura buyer volumes found.

also.product: Extruder screws and dies for coconut-shell charcoal briquette makers
also.why: PT Panda Coco Charcoal makes coconut-shell briquettes in Sumenep (Polije study, 2023). Extruder screws and dies wear fast and are machinable. Single-firm evidence, so low confidence.
